points.quote: It splits into a generic framework and the AFFiNE-specific editor built on it.
`store`: the document data layer. It holds the block models, doc collection and schema, and is presumably CRDT-backed.
`std`: the standard runtime. It covers the block service and view layer, the extension system, commands, selection and the gfx (edgeless canvas) core.
`widgets/*`: UI overlays and tools, such as slash-menu, toolbar, drag-handle... `fragments/*`: side panels, such as outline, frame-panel, doc-title and adapter-panel.
The app code is in `packages/frontend/core/src/blocksuite/`. It imports `@blocksuite/affine/*`, `@blocksuite/std` and `@blocksuite/store` in about 246 files.
